authority: NONE / COORDINATION ONLY until separately granted by the runtime owner
mission: Continue HOUSE as a small semantic/evidence layer above Home Assistant rather than expanding it into another automation platform.
ground_truth: HOUSE owns stable identity, relations, capability meaning, observations, intents and receipts.
Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS owns private runtime truth and actuation.
The public repository is not live runtime truth and contains no runtime credentials.
Existing DESIGN, REALITY, CARE and CREW machinery are optional projections/plugins, not kernel dependencies.
Normal operation should demand almost no interface attention; deviations should expose consequence, next move and evidence.

current_implementation.core: Pure zero-dependency JS kernel with stable bindings, normalized observations, availability, freshness, reconnect state machine, receipts, replay and diagnostics.
current_implementation.ha_contract: Machine-readable v0.1 contract; default execution mode is shadow.
current_implementation.runtime_connection: NOT IMPLEMENTED IN THIS PUBLIC BRANCH; private HA/HOUSEBUS binding remains separate.

next_moves.action: Create explicit HOUSE_ID + capability mappings for 10 already-known HA entities/devices. Do not generalize before these work.
next_moves.proof: No duplicate HOUSE identity; rename/replacement test preserves identity.

next_moves.action: Translate HA state/event updates into HouseOSCore observations and availability records; append them to a private replay fixture/log.
next_moves.proof: Restart/reconnect converges and current projection can be reproduced from replay.

next_moves.action: Compile a small set of light/fan intents to exact HA operations but emit WOULD_SEND only.
next_moves.proof: No side effects; each proposed operation has a receipt and can be replayed.

next_moves.action: Render only deviations, uncertain/stale state, consequence and smallest next action. Keep deep device trees in expert view.
next_moves.proof: A normal household state is nearly silent; a failure explains what changed and what depends on it.

stop_conditions: Do not introduce a second device runtime such as openHAB merely to model the same devices.
Do not create a new automation DSL before read/replay/shadow behavior is proven.
Do not place HA entity IDs, MQTT topics or vendor IDs in public UI as canonical identity.
Do not let an agent call arbitrary HA services through this seam.
Do not copy credentials, private endpoints, presence history or private topology into the public repository.
human_needed_only_for: choosing or confirming ambiguous physical identity
fresh world observations that cannot be inferred
permission to promote a capability from shadow to act
agent_can_do_without_rebrief: inspect public HOUSE contracts and code
propose mapping tables from runtime metadata once access exists
refactor projections while preserving kernel boundaries
handoff_prompt: Read /house/os/handoff.json first. Preserve the six-noun kernel and authority split. Continue from the first unproven next_move. Prefer deleting/merging concepts over adding subsystems. Return evidence, blockers, changed files, and the smallest next executable step.
